identity.name: E1 - The Tactical Terminal
identity.description: A sports analytics interface that borrows the visual language of Bloomberg terminals and cyberpunk tactical displays. It rejects the 'friendly' SaaS look for a 'professional tool' aesthetic.

tracing_beam.description: A glowing gradient border that travels around the container edge. Use for 'High Probability' cards.
tracing_beam.implementation: Use a mask-image with a moving gradient background or Framer Motion SVG path tracing.

grid_background.description: Subtle utilitarian grid pattern on the background to reinforce precision.
grid_background.css: background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #1e293b 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, #1e293b 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 40px 40px; mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, black, transparent 80%);

glass_panel.description: For sticky headers or overlays. High blur, low opacity.

StatsCard.description: Primary game display unit. Shows teams, odds, and probability score.
StatsCard.structure: Grid layout. Top: League/Time. Middle: Team Names vs Odds. Bottom: Probability Meter + Action Buttons.
StatsCard.style: border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/50 hover:bg-slate-900 transition-colors duration-200

SignalMeter.structure: Radial progress bar or segmented horizontal bar. Color coded (Green > 70%, Yellow > 50%, Red < 50%).

ConfigurationPanel.description: Dense form for setting odds thresholds.
ConfigurationPanel.style: Uses Shadcn Form, Input, Switch. Inputs should be 'h-9' and dense. Labels uppercase and small.

hero_background.description: Empty stadium night, dark mode background

corner_context.description: Corner flag and ball, used for empty states or feature highlights

general: Implement Dark Mode by default. Do not create a light mode toggle unless requested.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numerical data (odds, time, corners).
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all Team Names and Section Headers.
The 'Extension Popup' must use standard HTML/CSS/JS in the `/extension` folder, but share the same visual language as the Dashboard (React).
For the Dashboard, use Shadcn components but override their default 'radius' to be small (rounded-sm or rounded-md), never large rounded-xl.
Ensure high contrast for the 'Signal' indicators. A user must know instantly if a game is a 'GO'.
charts: Chart tooltip must be dark with neon accents.
Avoid grid lines in charts; use axes only.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'SaaS Blue' and 'Bootstrap' layouts.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable in the Dashboard, but COMPACT spacing in the Extension.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
